newsitem.title: FRANCE: Dassault Electronique sees 97 sales up 10 pct.
newsitem.headline: Dassault Electronique sees 97 sales up 10 pct.

text.p: Dassault Electronique said on Tuesday it expected 1997 turnover to be around five billion francs, 10 percent higher than 1996 sales.
The company set a 1996 net dividend of 6.40 francs.

Chairman Bertrand Daugny told a shareholders meeting that he "remained concerned by the hesitant pace of orders due to the reduction in military budgets, notwithstanding the increase in civil activities," the company said in a statement.
He said the group's profit, which was "already appreciable," should increase.
The sales increase would be due to higher export billings in defence and civilian activities.
